value.title: Client-Side & Server-Side Prototype Pollution Methodology
value.content: {"id": "portswigger_prototype_pollution", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "prototype_pollution", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Prototype Pollution", "name": "Client-Side & Server-Side Prototype Pollution Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-1321", "owasp_category": "A03:2021 - Injection", "signals": ["proto_property_in_json", "constructor_prototype_in_query", "recursive_object_merge", "client_side_prototype_pollution_sink", "server_side_nodejs_child_process"], "verification_strategy": "Inject benign property mutations (__proto__[canary]=true or constructor[prototype][canary]=true) into query strings, hash fragments, or JSON POST bodies. In client-side testing, evaluate if Object.prototype.canary evaluates to true in the console. In server-side Node.js testing, observe differential response or status.", "evidence_requirements": ["polluted_property_reflection", "object_prototype_canary_proof", "dom_gadget_trigger_trace"], "tools": [{"tool": "BrowserAgent (Prototype Pollution)", "cmd": "BrowserAgent.probe_prototype_pollution(url)", "desc": "Fuzzes query parameters for prototype injection and audits Object.prototype for new properties"}, {"tool": "DOM Invader (Burp Suite)", "cmd": "DOMInvader.scan_prototype_pollution(target)", "desc": "Discovers client-side prototype pollution sources and gadget flows in DOM"}], "remediation": "Use Object.create(null) for dictionary objects without prototypes. Freeze Object.prototype using Object.freeze(). Validate and sanitize user keys to block '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype'.", "description": "PortSwigger Prototype Pollution curriculum covers client-side pollution leading to DOM XSS, prototype pollution gadgets in third-party libraries, and server-side prototype pollution in Node.js applications triggering remote code execution."}
